name: All Scheduled Tasks
description: List all scheduled task nodes ingested by TaskHound. Use this to verify OpenGraph data was imported correctly.

name: All Windows Services
description: List all Windows service nodes ingested by TaskHound. Use this to verify service OpenGraph data was imported correctly.

name: Tasks with Stored Credentials (Full Path)
description: Show the full attack path: Computer -> Task (with stored creds) -> RunAs User. These are the highest-priority findings -- stored credentials can be extracted with local admin access.

name: Services with Stored Credentials (Full Path)
description: Show the full attack path: Computer -> Service (with stored creds) -> RunAs User. All domain-account services store credentials as LSA secrets.

name: TIER-0 Scheduled Tasks
description: Tasks running as Tier-0 principals (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, etc.). These represent the most critical privilege escalation opportunities.
query:
MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[]->(t:TH_ScheduledTask)-[:TH_RunsAs]->(u)
WHERE t.tasktype = 'TIER-0'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: TIER-0 Windows Services
description: Services running as Tier-0 principals. Critical findings -- extracting these credentials grants domain admin access.
query:
MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[]->(s:TH_WindowsService)-[:TH_RunsAs]->(u)
WHERE s.serviceclassification = 'TIER-0'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Tasks with Decrypted Passwords
description: Tasks where TaskHound successfully extracted the stored password via DPAPI. Shows hostname, task name, RunAs account, and the plaintext password.
query:
MATCH (t:TH_ScheduledTask)
WHERE t.password <> 'none'
RETURN t.hostname AS Host, t.name AS Task, t.runas AS RunAs, t.password AS Password
LIMIT 1000

name: Services with Extracted Credentials
description: Services where TaskHound successfully extracted credentials from LSA secrets. Shows hostname, service name, service account, and the password or NTLM hash.
query:
MATCH (s:TH_WindowsService)
WHERE s.password <> 'none'
RETURN s.hostname AS Host, s.name AS Service, s.startname AS Account, s.password AS Password, s.isgmsa AS gMSA
LIMIT 1000

name: gMSA Services
description: Services using Group Managed Service Accounts. While gMSA passwords auto-rotate, the current NTLM hash is still extractable from LSA secrets.
query:
MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[]->(s:TH_WindowsService {isgmsa: true})-[:TH_RunsAs]->(u)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Tasks Running as Domain Admins
description: Full attack path from Computer through Task to User to Domain Admins group. Shows how local admin on one host leads to domain admin via stored task credentials.
query:
MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[]->(t:TH_ScheduledTask)-[:TH_RunsAs]->(u)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group)
WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Services Running as Domain Admins
description: Full attack path from Computer through Service to User to Domain Admins group. Shows how local admin on one host leads to domain admin via extracted service credentials.
query:
MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[]->(s:TH_WindowsService)-[:TH_RunsAs]->(u)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group)
WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Hosts with Most Privileged Tasks and Services
description: Rank computers by how many TIER-0 or PRIV tasks and services they host. Prioritize these hosts for remediation.
query:
MATCH (c:Computer)-[]->(n:TaskHound)
WHERE n.tasktype IN ['TIER-0', 'PRIV'] OR n.serviceclassification IN ['TIER-0', 'PRIV']
RETURN c.name AS Computer, count(n) AS PrivilegedCount
ORDER BY PrivilegedCount DESC
LIMIT 100

name: Stale Credential Tasks
description: Tasks flagged with stale password analysis. The stored password may no longer be valid, or the password was changed after the task was created.
query:
MATCH (t:TH_ScheduledTask)
WHERE t.passwordanalysis IS NOT NULL
RETURN t.hostname AS Host, t.name AS Task, t.runas AS RunAs, t.passwordanalysis AS Analysis
LIMIT 1000

name: Shortest Path: Task Account to Domain Admins
description: Find the shortest path from any scheduled task RunAs account to the Domain Admins group. Combines TaskHound data with BloodHound's standard attack path analysis.
query:
MATCH (t:TH_ScheduledTask)-[:TH_RunsAs]->(u)
WITH u
MATCH p=shortestPath((u)-[*1..]->(g:Group))
WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512'
RETURN p
LIMIT 50

name: Shortest Path: Service Account to Domain Admins
description: Find the shortest path from any Windows service RunAs account to the Domain Admins group. Combines TaskHound service data with BloodHound's standard attack path analysis.
query:
MATCH (s:TH_WindowsService)-[:TH_RunsAs]->(u)
WITH u
MATCH p=shortestPath((u)-[*1..]->(g:Group))
WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512'
RETURN p
LIMIT 50
